messages:
Tara (CS): Quick weekly check-in on AtlasHealth dedicated pool. Noticed a mid-week spike in queue wait times and a small uptick in failures. Sharing current numbers, can folks confirm? :eyes:

Maya (AtlasHealth): Saw end-users hit higher latency around Wed 15:40 UTC. We had a few internal retries but didn't open a support ticket yet. Anything I should change on our side?

Sam (Eng Infra): Snapshot from monitoring:
- GPU hours (7d): 4,950 (↓8% w/w)
- Peak saturation: 92% (3h window)
- Avg queue depth: 7.1
- p95 serving wait: 1.6s
- error rate: 0.95% (mainly OOMs on rerank route)
- billable spend (7d est): $40.2k

Leo (SRE): Correlated logs show model 'redwood-rlhf-3b-quant' hitting occasional NV memory pressure during long-context reranks. OOM traces attached in infra ticket 9876. :warning:

Tara (CS): Thanks. Maya — are you running longer contexts or larger batch sizes this week? Any rollout?

Maya (AtlasHealth): We rolled a config that increased max_context to 12k for the 'patient-summarize' route on Tue. Batch size unchanged.

Sam (Eng Infra): That explains it. Longer context => larger KV cache => memory spike. Quick mitigations:
1) Enable prefix KVCaching for summarize routes (reduces duplicate work)
2) Limit max_context to 8k for peak hours
3) Autoscale: +2 GPUs for 3h window (Thu 14-17 UTC)

Config snippet to enable KVCaching:
```
pool_config:
  routes:
    - name: patient-summarize
      kv_caching: true
      max_context: 8192
```

Leo (SRE): I'll open an infra task to adjust pool autoscale policy and bump padding. Ticket 9880 — assigned to Sam. I'll also add an alert for NV memory pressure > 70% for 10m.

Sam (Eng Infra): Plan: apply KV caching, roll back max_context for peak hours, schedule autoscale bump tonight at 02:00 UTC. Will run a dry-run command:
`rbx pool-update --tenant atlashealth --patch autoscale_burst=2 --when 2026-03-21T02:00Z`

Tara (CS): Good. Renewal risk: low for now — customer usage still healthy and they appreciate new context support, but need to avoid repeated OOMs. Action items:
- Sam: implement KV caching + autoscale bump (owner)
- Leo: create memory-pressure alert and link tickets (owner)
- Maya: verify no other routes changed and share any config rollouts
Target: reduce p95 serving wait <1.0s and error rate <0.3% by Mon EOD.

Maya (AtlasHealth): Acknowledged. Will pause the long-context rollout during peak hours and report back after next run. :+1:

Tara (CS): I'll update account success notes and flag for renewal call next month if metrics stabilize. Thanks team :raised_hands:

ops-bot: Deploy job remoted at 2026-03-20T01:38:07Z — pool autoscale policy v2 queued.
